farming.descriptionEn: Plant crops, raise animals, and build your dream farm. From pixel-art classics to modern 3D farming simulators.
farming.descriptionZh: 种庄稼、养动物、打造梦想农场。从像素经典到现代3D农场模拟。

cozy.descriptionEn: Low-stress, high-charm games to unwind with. No time pressure, no fail states — pure relaxation.
cozy.descriptionZh: 低压高魅力的放松游戏。没有时间压力，没有失败惩罚——纯粹放松。

city-builder.descriptionEn: Design, build, and manage cities. From ancient settlements to futuristic metropolises — if it involves zoning and infrastructure, it's here.
city-builder.descriptionZh: 设计、建造、管理城市。从古代定居点到未来大都市——只要涉及分区和基建，这里都有。

management.descriptionEn: Optimize, plan, and expand. Management games reward smart decisions across supply chains, colonies, theme parks, and more.
management.descriptionZh: 优化、规划、扩张。管理模拟游戏奖励供应链、殖民地、主题公园等场景中的聪明决策。

colony-sim.descriptionEn: Guide a group of settlers through survival, growth, and prosperity. Manage individual needs, build defenses, and write your own stories.
colony-sim.descriptionZh: 带领一群定居者经历生存、成长、繁荣。管理个人需求、建造防御、书写自己的故事。

simulation.descriptionEn: Realistic simulations of farming, construction, life, and industry. Deep mechanics for players who love mastering complex systems.
simulation.descriptionZh: 农场、建筑、生活、工业的真实模拟。适合喜欢掌握复杂系统的深度玩家。

strategy.descriptionEn: Plan your moves, outsmart opponents, and build empires. Turn-based and real-time strategy that rewards deep thinking.
strategy.descriptionZh: 规划行动、智胜对手、建造帝国。回合制和即时策略，奖励深度思考。

single-player.descriptionEn: Games designed for solo play. Immerse yourself at your own pace without depending on other players.
single-player.descriptionZh: 为单人体验设计的游戏。按自己的节奏沉浸其中，不依赖其他玩家。

multiplayer.descriptionEn: Play with friends or strangers. Cooperative and competitive multiplayer experiences.
multiplayer.descriptionZh: 和朋友或陌生人一起玩。合作和竞技类联机体验。

co-op.descriptionEn: Team up and play together. Cooperative games where you work with other players toward shared goals.
co-op.descriptionZh: 组队一起玩。和其他玩家合作，一起达成共同目标。

chinese-language.descriptionEn: Games that include Simplified or Traditional Chinese localization. Full text and UI in Chinese.
chinese-language.descriptionZh: 包含简体或繁体中文本地化的游戏。文本和界面全中文。

early-access.descriptionEn: Games still in active development. Play now and watch them grow with updates.
early-access.descriptionZh: 仍在积极开发中的游戏。现在体验，看着它们随更新成长。
